newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht edges up as dlr idles, interbank steady.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht edges up as dlr idles, interbank steady.

text.p: The Thai baht edged up against the dollar in late trade on Thursday as the greenback idled against majors after German central bank comments that the American unit had gone up far enough, traders said.
The bid/offer range was quoted at 25.990-26.001 late on Thursday against 26.001-26.017 earlier in the day.
"It was trading in a range today as dollar gains appeared to be capped, the market appeared to be normal," said a dealer at Siam Commercial Bank.
